# Model-document reference (generated)

The authoring vocabulary of a `.rdj.json` model document, extracted from the loaded `ReactiveDynamics` module so it cannot drift from the engine. The normative semantics live in `spec/CONTRACT_DRAFT.md`; this is the surface.

A model is ONE JSON object. `meta.tspan` is required; everything else is optional and defaulted.

## Top-level keys

`rd_format` · `version` · `meta` · `params` · `places` · `transitions` · `arcs` · `observables` · `population` · `rules` · `inputs`

## Object model

| Object | JSON | Rows are |
|---|---|---|
| `:S` | `places[]` | one resource pool or structured-token container per row |
| `:T` | `transitions[]` | one static transition recipe per row |
| `:P` | `params[]` | one model parameter per row |
| `:obs` | `observables[]` | one named computed value per row |
| `:M` | `meta{}` | solver settings, as an object not an array — every key is passed through as a constructor keyword |

Column names per object, as the store declares them (`RD.SCHEMA`):

- **`:S`** — `placeCost`, `placeDefaultModality`, `placeInitUncertainty`, `placeInitVal`, `placeName`, `placeReward`, `placeRole`, `placeStructured`, `placeValuation`
- **`:T`** — `trans`, `transCapacity`, `transCycleTime`, `transMaxLifeTime`, `transMultiplier`, `transName`, `transPostAction`, `transPreAction`, `transPriority`, `transProbOfSuccess`, `transRate`
- **`:P`** — `prmName`, `prmVal`
- **`:obs`** — `obsName`, `obsOpts`
- **`:M`** — `metaKeyword`, `metaVal`

## JSON keys

| JSON path | Store column | Meaning |
|---|---|---|
| `meta.tspan` | `metaVal` | REQUIRED — the horizon, in ticks |
| `meta.dt` | `metaVal` | tick length (default `tunit`) |
| `meta.tunit` | `metaVal` | the time unit `tspan`/`dt` are expressed in |
| `params[].name` | `prmName` | parameter name; target of a `ref` node with `kind: "param"` |
| `params[].value` | `prmVal` | a JSON number, never an expression |
| `observables[].name` | `obsName` | observable name; target of a `ref` node with `kind: "obs"` |
| `places[].name` | `placeName` | the place's name; referenced by arcs and by `ref` nodes |
| `places[].init` | `placeInitVal` | initial marking (omit for 0) |
| `places[].structured` | `placeStructured` | `true` for a token container |
| `places[].cost` | `placeCost` | per-unit ledger cost charged when the place is drawn |
| `places[].reward` | `placeReward` | per-unit ledger reward credited when the place is PRODUCED |
| `places[].valuation` | `placeValuation` | per-unit carrying valuation |
| `places[].modality` | `placeDefaultModality` | default modality for arcs on this place that omit one |
| `transitions[].id` | `transName` | REQUIRED — the FK arcs point at |
| `transitions[].name` | `transName` | display name (defaults to `id`) |
| `transitions[].rate` | `transRate` | spawn rate — a node or a bare number |
| `transitions[].rate_mode` | `—` | `"poisson"` (default) or `"deterministic"` for a fixed count |
| `transitions[].cycletime` | `transCycleTime` | ticks an instance stays in flight |
| `transitions[].prob_of_success` | `transProbOfSuccess` | terminal success probability, in [0,1] |
| `transitions[].priority` | `transPriority` | allocator weight under contention (ADR 0002) |
| `transitions[].capacity` | `transCapacity` | max simultaneous in-flight instances |
| `transitions[].multiplier` | `transMultiplier` | scales every arc's multiplicity |
| `transitions[].max_lifetime` | `transMaxLifeTime` | abandon an instance after this long |
| `transitions[].pre_action` | `transPreAction` | action fired when an instance spawns |
| `transitions[].post_action` | `transPostAction` | action fired when an instance completes |
| `arcs[].transition` | `ArcSpec.trans` | REQUIRED — the owning transition's `id` |
| `arcs[].side` | `ArcSpec.side` | REQUIRED — `"lhs"` (input) or `"rhs"` (output) |
| `arcs[].place` | `ArcSpec.place` | the place, for a static arc |
| `arcs[].multiplicity` | `ArcSpec.multiplicity` | coefficient (default 1) |
| `arcs[].modality` | `ArcSpec.modality` | `{allocation, return, blocking}` — see below |
| `arcs[].predicate` | `—` | lhs token selection: `{kind, clauses:[[field,op,node]]}` (a `@select`) — no `place` key; the `kind` IS the place |
| `arcs[].advance` | `—` | rhs field write on the bound token: `{field, value:node}` (an `@advance`) — no `place` key |
| `arcs[].structured` | `—` | rhs token genesis: `{kind, fields:[{name,value:node}]}` (a `@structured`) — no `place` key |
| `population[].place` | `—` | structured place the starting tokens go on |
| `population[].kind` | `—` | registry key resolved to a host constructor |
| `population[].count` | `—` | how many to instantiate (default 1) — applied by `rdx`, see below |
| `population[].attributes` | `—` | field ⇒ literal; `":Sym"` denotes a Symbol — applied by `rdx`, see below |

`meta` is the one OPEN key set: every key is passed through as a constructor keyword, so it accepts more than the rows above (and silently ignores what the constructor does not use — `alloc_strategy` is accepted-and-ignored since ADR 0002 made the priority-weighted allocator unconditional). Everything else is a closed vocabulary.

Columns with NO document key — set only by the Julia DSL, so do not invent a JSON spelling for them:

- `placeRole` — authoring-time role tag, set by the DSL
- `placeInitUncertainty` — initial-marking uncertainty, set by the DSL
- `trans` — the raw reaction line — DSL provenance, reconstructed on import

## Arc modality — the three axes

An input arc's `modality` is an object with three independent axes. **Omitting it means `consumed`**, which is the single most common modeling error: a reusable resource (headcount, equipment, bench capacity) declared by default is *spent* rather than occupied, so its pool drains and never recovers.

| Axis | Values | Note |
|---|---|---|
| `allocation` | `upfront` (default) · `perstep` | `perstep` is the `@rate` marker — metered each tick over the cycle |
| `return` | `consumed` (DEFAULT) · `conserved` | `conserved` is the `@conserved` marker — held for the cycle, returned intact |
| `blocking` | `block` (default) · `nonblock` | `nonblock` is the `@nonblock` marker — a read/test arc that neither holds nor spends |

Illegal combinations are rejected at construction (CONTRACT §1.4): `{nonblock, conserved}`; `perstep` with `cycletime == 0`; `perstep` on a structured place.

## Expression nodes (the closed IR)

Every time-varying attribute is a node tree, never a source string — this is the eval-free trust boundary (ADR 0005). A bare number is accepted as shorthand for `const`.

| Tag | Shape |
|---|---|
| `const` | `{"node":"const","value":v,"symbol":false}` — `symbol: true` makes the value a Symbol name |
| `ref` | `{"node":"ref","kind":"place"\|"param"\|"obs","name":"n"}` |
| `call` | `{"node":"call","op":"+","args":[…]}` |
| `sample` | `{"node":"sample","dist":"Poisson","args":[…]}` |
| `timeref` | `{"node":"timeref"}` — the current tick |
| `choose` | `{"node":"choose","alts":[{"weight":w,"value":node}]}` |
| `field` | `{"node":"field","name":"f"}` — a bound token's field |
| `externalref` | `{"node":"externalref","port":"p"}` — a declared AA input port |

**Operator whitelist** (`RD.OP_WHITELIST`): `+` · `-` · `*` · `/` · `^` · `>` · `<` · `>=` · `<=` · `==` · `!=` · `&&` · `||` · `!` · `min` · `max` · `exp` · `log` · `floor` · `ceil` · `abs`

**Distribution whitelist** (`RD.DIST_WHITELIST`): `Poisson` · `Binomial` · `Normal` · `Uniform` · `Exponential` · `Bernoulli` · `LogNormal` · `Gamma` · `Beta`

**Reference kinds** (`RD.REF_KINDS`): `place` · `param` · `obs`

Anything outside these tuples is a validation error, not a fallback. There is no escape to arbitrary Julia.

## Token selection and lifecycle

**Predicate clause operators** (`RD.PRED_OP_WHITELIST`): `==` · `!=` · `<` · `<=` · `>` · `>=` · `in`

A clause is a 3-element array `[field, op, node]`. A predicate is `{"kind":"K","clauses":[…]}` and selects tokens of kind `K` satisfying every clause.

### Starting population — read by `rdx`, not by the engine

`population[]` declares the t=0 tokens. `validate` checks it (the `place` must be a declared structured place; the `kind` must be in the registry), but `from_json_model` does NOT instantiate it — it constructs the network and drops the array. `rdx` closes the gap: it reads `population[]` itself and passes `PopulationEntry(place, kind; count, attributes)` to the constructor. The practical consequence: **a document's starting tokens materialize under `rdx`, and silently do not under a bare `from_json_model` call.** (Charter W14 — the fix belongs upstream in the engine.)

`attributes` values are literals only, on a closed whitelist: numbers, strings, booleans, and `":Name"` for a Symbol. Anything else is rejected — an attribute is not an expression.

## Rule action verbs

The endogenous decision channel (ADR 0010): a `rules[]` entry is `{id, guard, action, fire_mode}`. Action verbs (`RD.ACTION_VERBS`):

`set_marking` · `set_params` · `set_field` · `set_tokens` · `add_token` · `activate` · `deactivate` · `invoke` · `log` · `seq`

`invoke` and a `add_token` kind are resolved through the per-network registry BY NAME — the host-code seam, never inline source.

## Validation

`ReactiveDynamics.validate(dict; registry) -> Vector{Diagnostic}` is a pure, eval-free static pass, and `from_json_model` refuses to construct unless it returns empty. Each `Diagnostic` carries a `severity`, a JSON `path` and a message — the path is what makes a failure machine-repairable. Run it (via `rdx validate`) before every simulate.
